metaTitle: Custom 18 oz Classic C Handle Mugs | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom 18 oz classic c handle mugs for your team or event. Durable, heat-retaining, and perfect for branding with your logo. Shop now.
introHtml: An 18 oz classic c handle mug offers a generous capacity that holds more coffee or tea than standard 14 or 15 oz options, making it ideal for long meetings or breakroom use. The sturdy handle and thick ceramic walls keep beverages hot longer, while the wide imprint area provides excellent visibility for your logo or message. These mugs are a popular choice for employee gifts, trade show giveaways, and corporate holiday presents. Decorate with a full-color wrap or a simple one-color screen print to match your brand.
heroAltText: Custom 18 oz classic c handle mugs with ceramic construction and large imprint area for logo branding
